meta.name: para-second-brain
meta.description: Organize your agent's knowledge using PARA (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive) — then make it ALL searchable. The symlink trick enables full semantic search across your entire knowledge base, not just MEMORY.md. Includes session transcript indexing and memory flush protocol. Your agent finally has a real second brain.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 PARA 方法组织知识并实现全文搜索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用 PARA 框架管理 agent 知识库并支持语义搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Organize knowledge with PARA method and enable full-text search
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to manage your agent's knowledge base with PARA framework and enable semantic search.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 PARA 方法（项目、领域、资源、归档）来组织你的笔记，并通过符号链接让所有笔记都能被语义搜索到。它还会记录会话日志，并在上下文快满时提醒你保存重要信息。
howto.when: 当你询问笔记中的内容，或上下文使用率超过 50% 时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 notes/projects 里关于网站改版的笔记。
say.note: Claude 会搜索整个笔记文件夹。

say.text: 当前上下文使用率是多少？
把今天的对话要点记录到 memory/2025-03-21.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建或更新当天的日志文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude organizes your notes using the PARA method (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive) and makes all notes searchable via a symlink. It also indexes session transcripts and prompts you to save important context before compaction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about content in your notes, or when context usage exceeds 50%.

say_en.text: Find notes about website redesign in notes/projects.
say_en.note: Claude searches the entire notes folder.

say_en.text: What is the current context usage?
say_en.note: Claude runs session_status and reports usage.

say_en.text: Log today's key points to memory/2025-03-21.md.
say_en.note: Claude creates or updates the daily log file.
